answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The vine of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The signal lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the spiral is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
